anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.

steps_heic-to-jpg_1Desc: Select HEIC images from your iPhone or iPad. HEIC is Apple's default photo format — converting to JPEG ensures compatibility with all devices and platforms.
steps_heic-to-jpg_2Desc: Adjust the JPEG quality level. Higher settings preserve more detail from the original HEIC photo. The default setting works well for most photos.
steps_heic-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform HEIC into universally compatible JPEG files. Share, upload, or edit your photos anywhere — no Apple device required.
